# পুলের রিকোয়েস্ট / Pull Request

## বিবরণ / Description
Please describe your changes and the user problem they solve.

## টাইপ / Type of Change
- [ ] 🎨 **Palette (UX/UI)** — Micro-UX or accessibility enhancement
- [ ] ⚡ **Bolt (Performance)** — Speed, build, or workflow optimization
- [ ] 🛡️ **Sentinel (Security)** — Hardening or dependency security
- [ ] 🐛 **Bug Fix** — Error resolution

## অ্যাক্সেসিবিলিটি চেকলিস্ট / Accessibility Checklist
- [ ] All icon-only buttons include an explicit `aria-label`.
- [ ] Proper semantic HTML tags (e.g., `<main>`, `<nav>`, `<button>`) are utilized.
- [ ] Proper keyboard focus navigation (`tabindex`, `focus-visible` outline) is supported.
- [ ] Images contain meaningful alternative descriptions (`alt` text).
